Mirzapur Varoon Video Song - Remember Guddu & Sweety's wedding song which had stuck in our mind for a long time? Presenting soulful Varoon Sufi Song composed by Anand Bhaskar in the lyrics of Ginni Dewan from much-loved Amazon Original Mirzapur Season 1.
Music credit
Song Name : Vaaroon
Composer: Anand Bhaskar

Lyrics: Ginny Diwan
Mixed & Mastered By: Prathamesh Dudhane
